- Can you confirm the preferred notice window for penetration testing (we proposed 14 days in the doc)?
- Is a scoped, time-boxed staging environment acceptable for evidence access, or do you require privileged live-system inspection?
- Please confirm your primary point of contact for evidence uploads and scan coordination (we suggested devops+security@healthgrid.com).

- Redwood: Olga Petrov (security) and Karthik Iyer (legal support)

From: Matt Hughes <matt.hughes@healthgrid.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: devops+security@healthgrid.com, contracts@healthgrid.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form: security exhibit — scope & owner roster

Jordan — thanks for the draft. A few quick notes after an initial read and an internal check with legal/ops: 

1) Inspection language: We can't agree to unrestricted "inspection" of production systems. Our preference is for a bounded, time-boxed staging environment with read-only access and scoped data samples.
2) Pen-test window: 30 days' notice is preferable for our compliance calendar; we can accommodate a shorter window for low-impact scans but need 30 days for full-scope tests.
3) SOC 2: we'll provide a copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; we expect Redwood to accept the SOC 2 attestation in lieu of frequent live evidence pulls.

We'll work on a marked-up redline and can send our suggested edits to the exhibit by EOD tomorrow. DevOps/security is prepared to receive a pen-test plan but will need a diagram of IP ranges and target lists ahead of time (please see pen-test-scope-diagram.png request).

Matt
Contracts Manager — HealthGrid
matt.hughes@healthgrid.com

Attachment: HealthGrid_requested_redlines_v1.docx (will follow)

--

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, matt.hughes@healthgrid.com, devops+security@healthgrid.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form: security exhibit — scope & owner roster

Thanks Matt — appreciate the quick read and the constraints. Quoting your key points below for clarity:

> We can't agree to unrestricted "inspection" of production systems.
> Prefer bounded, time-boxed staging environment with read-only access.
> 30 days' notice for full-scope pen tests; shorter windows for low-impact scans possible.
> Will provide SOC 2 report under NDA.

From Redwood's perspective, two clarifications that will help our legal team accept the exhibit:

1) Bounded inspection language: We can accept a staging-first approach if the exhibit explicitly allows an annual on-production, forensic-limited inspection for confirmed incidents or regulatory needs (we can define "forensic-limited" in the exhibit). We want to avoid a situation where we can't validate fixes after a security update.
2) Notice windows: healthgrid's 30-day request is understood — we can propose a compromise: 30 days for full-scope tests, 14 days for reduced-scope vulnerability scans. Put differently: Redwood will commit to respecting 30-day scheduling for full tests but requests option to run limited scans on a 14-day cadence for infra verification.
3) Evidence cadence: Instead of ad-hoc pulls, Redwood proposes a monthly evidence bundle (s3 link) with SOC 2 attestation uploaded quarterly. That reduces friction for both sides and creates an auditable timeline.

Action items I propose (owner in parentheses):
- Redwood to send a redline that (a) accepts staging-first approach and (b) inserts forensic-limited carveout language (Olga) — ETA tomorrow EOD.
- HealthGrid to upload suggested redlines and SOC 2 NDA process (Matt) — ETA tomorrow.
- Karthik to confirm acceptable wording for "forensic-limited inspection" and produce a short clause for legal (Karthik) — ETA Thu COB.
- Monica to create the monthly evidence bundle template and S3 sharing instructions (Monica) — ETA Fri.

If everyone is aligned, let's lock a 30-min call Wed 10:30 PT to go through the redlines and finalize owners.

Olga Petrov
Head of Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference

Attachment: Redwood_proposed_exhibit_redline_v1.docx (will attach in follow-up)

--

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: matt.hughes@healthgrid.com, devops+security@healthgrid.com
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, contracts@healthgrid.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form: security exhibit — scope & owner roster

Thanks all — good progress. Recap and agreed next steps from today's sync: 

Agreements:
- Inspection approach: staging-first for routine validation. One annual production forensic-limited inspection allowed with 30 days' mutually agreed notice for full-scope tests.
- Pen-test windows: Full-scope tests 30 days' notice; limited scans 14 days' notice.
- Evidence cadence: HealthGrid will provide a monthly evidence bundle (S3) and will share SOC 2 Type II under NDA quarterly.
- Diagram / targets: Redwood (Olga) will provide a pen-test target template and public IP range requirements — HealthGrid will confirm the target list 7 days before test start.

Assigned owners (confirmed):
- Redwood security lead: Olga Petrov — responsible for pen-test coordination and target template.
- Redwood legal contact: Karthik Iyer — final clause language.
- Evidence ops: Monica Patel — monthly bundle template + S3 instructions.
- HealthGrid contracts / ops: Matt Hughes + devops+security@healthgrid.com — redline delivery and SOC 2 upload process.

Next steps (timeline):
- HealthGrid to circulate marked redline by EOD Thu (Matt).
- Redwood to return a final exhibit accepting the staging-first language and adding the forensic-limited clause by Fri COB (Olga & Karthik).
- Monica will post the S3 template and a sample upload link to the shared Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid-evidence-playbook) by Fri.

If anything above looks off, flag now — otherwise we'll fold the agreed exhibit into the MSA/Order Form for signature.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
